bullets.text: Under supervision within a student team, wrote Python functions to parse provided programming question records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to provided metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.

As an individual contribution to supervised team research, implemented reusable Python modules for the news summary metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, validated pandas merges of news summary metadata with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
